latest_release.name: v3.15.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed?

- feat: add SASL username and password constants and implement SASL configuration retrieval in Kafka environment by @yuval-hazaz in [#9818](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9818)
- refactor: remove dsgResourceData from build request and implement shared storage for DSG resource data by @yuval-hazaz in [#9829](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9829)
- refactor: improve type safety in getOSVersion function by @yuval-hazaz in [#9831](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9831)
- chore:revert change by @yuval-hazaz in [#9832](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9832)
- feat: add debug logging for saving DSG resource data to shared storage by @yuval-hazaz in [#9833](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9833)
- feat: add configuration to disable user signups and restrict access to existing accounts by @yuval-hazaz in [#9871](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/pull/9871)



**Full Changelog**: [v3.14.0...v3.15.0](https://github.com/amplication/amplication/compare/v3.14.0...v3.15.0)
